purpose: Historical original controls and current development component inventory
backpack_policy: Keep Backpacked and every original keybind until the MineRENT release cutover. This historical snapshot is immutable even after future cleanup.
limitations: Keybinds are the saved options.txt values, including unknown and unassigned entries
Inventory describes files present, not proof that every optional pack is enabled
pack_format is a Minecraft compatibility format, never the pack version
Versions inferred from filenames are explicitly labelled
Missing declared versions remain not declared and have content SHA-256 identifiers
Source worktree contains unrelated uncommitted work, recorded source module metadata is not a source-code backup
Default mod data and resource contents are covered by their owning mod version and JAR hash
World saves and personal runtime data are excluded
snapshot_keybind_newlines: LF, original keybind row values and order unchanged
